final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It strips accent marks from the title before passing it to slugify. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because its header says not to edit it by hand.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) use the same vendored slugify and still drop accented letters. I left them alone since you only asked about blog posts. If you want them fixed too, the better change is probably to put the accent-stripping in one shared place.
